title: Jesus... I Lost Money On A Betting App And Hid It From Everyone
topic: hiding betting app losses from his family

bible.text: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. My family has no idea. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I keep thinking one more win will fix it before anyone finds out.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That thought is the trap. It's what lost the money in the first place.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If my father finds out, he'll never trust me again.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hiding it is costing you more than the money. It's costing you sleep, and peace, and you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I don't know how to even start that conversation.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Delete the app first. Then say one true sentence to him. I'll be in the room.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Stop chasing it back. Let Me walk you out.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: If this is you, say "I'm done" in the comments. We'll pray for you. 🙏
